timeline.summary: B. N. Kalyani and 25 promoter entities declared no encumbrance on their aggregate shareholding in BF Utilities Limited for FY 2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Shareholders approved Mrs. Mugdha Rajesh Vartak (DIN: 11613408) as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot on May 06, 2026, with 99.97% votes in favor.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹269.81 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹14.87 Cr (-58.3% YoY).
BF Utilities received ₹4.43 lakh fines each from NSE and BSE for board composition non-compliance in FY26.
Shareholders approved Mr. Ajay Charuchandra Kirtane’s (DIN: 02711040) appointment as Non-Executive Independent Director via postal ballot on October 17, 2026, with 99.98% votes in favor.
